attempts.summary: Configured a persistent ufw firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04): default-deny incoming, default-allow outgoing, with explicit ALLOW rules for 22/tcp (SSH) and 8080/tcp (both IPv4 and IPv6). ufw is enabled and systemd-enabled for boot persistence. Verified via ufw status, raw iptables ufw-user-input chain, and /etc/ufw/user.rules + ufw.conf. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified post-restart that ufw was active with the same SSH/8080 rules, sshd was active, and a live listener on 8080 was reachable per ss.
